items.information: ## Waterloo Favourites 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.information: **Svenska** Välkommen till första tävlingen någonsin i Kalmar! Vi påminner om att alla är varmt välkomna, vare sig du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi rekommenderar att du läser all information på sidan så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen är schemalagd så att om du inte deltar i Megaminx, 5x5, 6x6 eller 7x7 så behöver du inte vara närvarande förrän 14:05 på lördagen. Vi har också tyvärr fått sätta en gräns på ***en gäst per person*** eftersom lokalen inte är så stor. **English** Welcome to the competition ever in Kalmar! We remind you that everyone is welcome, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We recommend that you read all the information on this page to not miss any important information. The competition is scheduled so that if you don’t compete in Megaminx, 5x5, 6x6 or 7x7, you won’t have to be present until 2:05 PM on Saturday. We have also unfortunately had to set a limit of ***one guest per person*** because the venue is quite small.

items.name: Wellington Summer 2023
items.information: Wellington Summer 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

Open hau antzeko lehiaketetarako test bat izango da, lehiakide bakoitzak nahi dituen ekitaldietako batez bestekoak egingo ditu nahi duen ordenan. Parte hartzeko ezinbestekoa da [formulario hau](https://forms.gle/iWCecxy5zJgC5bv66) betetzea, eta bi taldeetan egon, hasieratik amaierara. Informazio gehiago LEHIAKETAREN FUNTZIONAMENDUA erlaitzean. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2N0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--83fc6c836b78e431cd8e0d013efd6be412a6e388/IMG_9500.JPG) Athens Winter Open 2023 είναι ο πρώτος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα , ύστερα από μία πολλά υποσχόμενη χρονιά. Στις επόμενες διοργανώσεις, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 διοργανώσεις που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστές στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 6x6 και του 7x7 πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλες οι εκδηλώσεις θα είναι οικείες στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή για το cubing γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείτε ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca και να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Athens Winter Open 2023 is the first competition this year in Greece, following a very successfull year of competitions. In the next competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 6x6 and 7x7 closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the eca site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information: Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. **OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag. -- A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition. **N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).** * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. * **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.** --- Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).** * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office. * **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2022 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. O uso de máscaras é recomendado! Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. The use of facial masks is recommended

items.information: Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen. -- Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: **Svenska** Välkommen till Östersund och den första tävlingen i Jämtland någonsin! Vi påminner om att alla är varmt välkomna, vare sig du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi rekommenderar att du läser all information på sidan så du inte missar någon viktig information. Tävlingen är schemalagd så att om du inte deltar i 3x3 med Ögonbindel, Clock, Megaminx, 6x6, 7x7 eller 3x3 med en Hand behöver du inte vara närvarande förrän 14:45 på lördagen. **English** Welcome to the first competition in Jämtland ever! We remind you that everyone is welcome, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We recommend that you read all the information on this page to not miss any important information. The competition is scheduled so that if you don’t compete in 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, 6x6, 7x7 or 3x3 One-Handed, you won’t have to be present until 2:45 PM on Saturday.

items.name: Buenos Aires Cubea 2022
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajBqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7beabe32163b26aed8c733e5c7562315ef48ade7/image.png) ¡Bienvenidos al **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! Este será un torneo enfocado en reunir competidores de todas partes del país debido a la gran capacidad del lugar. Habrá dos salones donde se realizarán las rondas simultáneamente. Este torneo consta de 10 categorías donde se dará más prioridad a las categorías más populares, teniendo así 4 rondas de 3x3 por primera vez en Argentina. Pedimos a los competidores nuevos que se familiaricen con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) y se presenten al menos 15 minutos antes del registro y para cualquier categoría en la que participen. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajRqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5a15438d910a9c0341cea28270f233e50066202/image.png) Welcome to **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! This will be a competition focused on gathering competitors from every part of the country due to the large capacity of the venue. There will be two rooms where the rounds will be held simultaneously. This competition consists of 10 events with more priority given to more popular events, thus having 4 rounds of 3x3 for the first time in Argentina. We ask new competitors to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and to show up at least 15 minutes prior to registration and for any event in which they participate.

items.information: ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. All competitors must be available to judge and scramble at this competition. Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewmarketSideEvents2022#21475-competitor-responsibilities). ## Nearby Competitions Newmarket Side Events 2022 features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. If you are looking to compete in 3x3x3 Cube, please consider registering for [Oakville Fall A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallA2022) *or* [Oakville Fall B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallB2022). ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

items.information: 11/3に行われる[Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (以下、A大会) と11/6に行われるAyase Autumn B 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、B大会**) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し **B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド)** 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 ###会場についての注意### 今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。 [Ayase Autumn A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnA2022) (A) and Ayase Autumn B 2022 (**This competition, B**) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind **B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round)** The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.** Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of **1 companion at MAX per competitor.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors) ### Attention ### In room 1 and 2, you have to take off your shoes. So, you must wear socks due to hygienic reasons.

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022! ### This year's UK National Championship ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size. **Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition. **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**. **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022. We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. [![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

items.information: Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. *Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!* ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion. *Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

items.information: 8/21に行われる[Yoga Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerA2022) (以下、A大会) と8/28に行われるYoga Summer B 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、B大会**) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。 ### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。 A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し **B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス** 新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。 飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。 会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。 競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。** また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。 [Yoga Summer A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerA2022) (A) and Yoga Summer B 2022 (**This competition, B**) are WCA Series Competitions. ### You can register either of these competitions. If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected. Please make sure that the events for A and B are different. A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded **B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx** The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure. **Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.** Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.** If the number of requests would become too many, a certain prioritization might be applied. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. items.name: Abierto del Mirador 2022
items.information: Bienvenidos al Abierto del Mirador 2022, nos complace traerles nuevamente un torneo a la Provincia de Buenos Aires. Nuestro evento contará con 10 categorías oficiales de la WCA distribuidas en 17 rondas. Solo se harán devoluciones del total del pago ($1000) a quienes estén en lista de espera una vez lleno el cupo de 60 competidores siempre y cuando se confirme que no asistirán al torneo antes del mismo, no se harán devoluciones luego del evento. Se aceptarán los registros por orden de llegada del e-mail correspondiente con comprobante a la casilla de correo del organizador. Pedimos que dentro de las posibilidades se atienda al torneo con un (1) acompañante por cuestiones de espacio físico en el lugar del torneo. Pedimos puntualidad a todos y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que el competidor vaya a participar. Welcome to Abierto del Mirador 2022, we are pleased to bring you again a tournament to the Province of Buenos Aires. Our competition will feature 10 official WCA events distributed in 17 rounds. Refunds of the total payment ($1000) will only be made to those who are on the waiting list once the quota of 60 competitors is filled as long as it is confirmed that they will not attend the tournament beforehand, no refunds will be made after the event. Registrations will be accepted on a first-come, first-served basis with proof of receipt to the organizer's e-mail address. We ask to attend, within the possibilities, with a maximum of one (1) companion for reasons of physical space at the tournament site. We ask for punctuality to all and recommend to arrive at least 15 minutes before any category in which the competitor will participate.

items.information: 8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte. En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year. So don't be afraid to join us. We'll be waiting for you!

items.information: NZ South Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss! Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid. Det koster 150 NOK å delta. Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). items.name: Cloverdale Open 2022
items.information: We're excited to welcome new and experienced cubers to Cloverdale, B.C., for the Cloverdale Open 2022 cubing competition. It's been a little while since we've seen cubing competitions in B.C., and we're thrilled to be one of the teams bringing cubers back together again to compete, connect, and have fun! Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. We'll be raising funds for the [Cloverdale Community Kitchen](https://www.mycck.ca), an organization that feeds the hungry, and provides care for individuals when they are struggling. Their vision is to help Cloverdale/Surrey/Langley be a healthy and caring community for everyone. 10% of registration fees will be donated to the Cloverdale Community Kitchen. Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** Email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes. We look forward to a full house of 60 competitors! Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

items.information: Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus. Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le premier tour du 3x3 : dimanche à 9h15 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription. Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence. Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**, elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles. En raison de la situation sanitaire, cette compétition aura un déroulement différent d'une compétition habituelle. Merci de **lire attentivement l'onglet [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19)** pour plus d'informations. ---- Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up. We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the 3x3 first round: therefore on Sunday at 9:15, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order, and those who are here will be able to compete in 3x3. If you are on the waiting list you can come in case a spot opens up, but we can't guarantee you will be able to compete, and entering the competition area will be possible only if there is enough room left. Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, they contain a lot of very useful information. Because of the sanitary situation, this competition will not look like an usual competition. **Please read the [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19) tab carefully** for more information.

items.information: # 🇺🇾 NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * Recomendamos que se asista con **máximo un acompañante**, ya que no podemos asegurar que haya suficientes lugares para que todos se puedan sentar. * Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19. Competitor limit: 40. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * It is strongly recommended to bring a maximum of **one guest per competitor**, given that there will not be enough seats for everyone. * Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.name: Hive Blind 2022
items.information: Välkommen till Hive Blind 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är en sista chans att kvalificera sig inför [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) i juli. Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men kom ihåg att denna tävling endast håller utvalda sido- och blindgrenar. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen. ### Vänligen notera: * **Vi förväntar oss en mycket hög efterfrågan jämfört med antalet tillgängliga deltagarplatser för den här tävlingen, så om du vill ha en plats måste du antagligen anmäla dig direkt när registreringen öppnar.** Anmälan öppnar tisdagen den 26:e april, klockan 20:00 svensk tid. * **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 20 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information. * **Lokalen ligger i matsalen på en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret. --- Welcome to Hive Blind 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is a last-chance-to qualify competition before the [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) in July. Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but remember that this competition only holds selected side and blind events. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition. ### Please note: * **We expect very high demand compared to available spots for this competition, so if you want a spot, you will likely need to register the very second when registration opens.** Registration opens on Tuesday 26th April, at 20:00 Swedish time. * **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 20 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information. * **The venue is located in the canteen of an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.

venue.address: Bv. Almte Brown 3049, Puerto Madryn, Chubut

items.information: "Madryn al Cubo 2022" contará con **7 categorias** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) y **11 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la region puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) y el [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 25, con **1 acompañante como maximo** (padre, madre, hermano, tutor, amigo, etc) pudiendose anotar a todas las categorias que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripcion. **Se ruega puntualidad**. Recomendamos llegar 15 minutos antes de cada ronda en la que vas a competir. *ENGLISH* "Madryn al Cubo 2022" will feature **7 categories** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) and **11 rounds** in total. The objective is that the competitors in the region can update their times and continue to improve. We have the experience of having organized [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) and [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) with great success. The maximum capacity of competitors will be 25, with a **maximum of 1 companion** (father, mother, brother, guardian, friend, etc.) being able to enter all the categories that they wish by paying only 1 registration. **Punctuality is necessary**. We recommend arriving 15 minutes before each round in which you are going to compete.

items.information: # REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento. ------------ **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. Bank Account: Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01. 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org). Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.

venue.details: Senate Chamber is located on the second floor of the Ohio Union, Rhodes Center is located at the Ohio Expo Center

items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. items.information: **Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022** será la primera competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país. Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA. **A las personas que estaban inscritas en Costa Rica Regresa (v1) se les solicita hacer el registro lo más rápido posible ** Por tal motivo se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia. El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia. Se solicitará carné de vacunación a los mayores de 12 años. Solo se permitirá un acompañante por persona. Cada competidor deberá llevar su propio lapicero. Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio. **.....................English version...................** Costa Rica Regresa V2 2022 will be the first official competition after the pandemic in the country. Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA. For this reason, the temperature will be taken at the entrance of the competition. The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition. Vaccination card will be requested from those over 12 years of age. We will only allow one companion per person. Each competitor must bring their own pen. We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 30 competitors and 30 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (lojagcubos@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores, sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). Máximo un acompañante por persona. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Leer toda la información disponible en esta página. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). Only one guest per competitor allowed. * This competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * Read all the information available in this website. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). El Seminario Teológico Nazareno del Perú, es una institución evangélica dedicada a la preparación de ministros cristianos, y nos está brindando gentilmente sus instalaciones para la realización del torneo, por lo tanto, se les pide un comportamiento adecuado al Instituto Religioso. Se nos está permitido usar el lugar de ceremonias donde se realizará el torneo, transitar por los espacios abietos, y usar los baños. Pero está prohibido entrar a las aulas, oficinas y demás instalaciones del local. ____ The results of this competition will enter the data base and WCA ranking, and the ones participating for the first time will acquire an official profile. For that reason, every competitor must know the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). The Nazarene Theological Seminary of Peru is an evangelical institution dedicated to the preparation of Christian ministers, and are giving us kindly their facilities for the realization of the tournament, therefore, it is asked to have an appropriate behavior to the Religious Institute. We are allowed to use the place of ceremonies where the tournament will take place, go through the open spaces, and use the bathrooms. But it's forbidden to enter classrooms, offices and any other of the facilities.

items.information: Popping Off Pukekohe A 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please note this is a **twin competition**. To make it fairer and more accessible to more competitiors during the current covid-19 restrictions, you will only be allowed to register for one competition - not both. items.information: Güemes Open 2022 es la primera competencia que se va a realizar en la provincia de Salta, Argentina, y a su vez, la primera competencia del 2022 del país! El objetivo de esta competencia es reactivar la comunidad norteña del país. Nos esforzaremos en hacer cumplir todos los protocolos pertinentes a la pandemia. Competidores, recuerden ser puntuales, siguiendo los horarios del cronograma. Recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes para evitar inconvenientes, en especial a los nuevos competidores. Este torneo contará con 11 categorias oficiales y tendrá una duración de 2 días. *LEER LOS SIGUIENTES APARTADOS* https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#17047-protocolos https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022/#16994-payment-pago https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuemesOpen2022#17085-requisitos-para-entrar-a-salta A pesar de no tener restricciones estrictas con la cantidad de personas que puede asistir y que el lugar es abierto y ventilado, recomendamos no llevar mas de 2 acompañantes para reducir al máximo los riesgos Güemes Open 2022 is the first competition to be held in the province of Salta, Argentina, and also, the first competition of 2022 in the country! The objective of this competition is to reactivate the northern community of the country. We will endeavor to enforce all protocols relevant to the pandemic. Competitors, remember to be punctual, following schedule. We recommend arriving 20 minutes before to avoid inconvenience, especially to new competitors. items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 30 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes, además, se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA. * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la categoría, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 30. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)). Please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Attention!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16710-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WelcomeBackLevis2021#16705-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques]https://docs.google.com/document/d/121IA2o1dPWAdlqZNCO0KyVLceeFsbFENTiVlMPThAkU/edit?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **1 accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans la cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA cancelle la compétition. items.information: **Español:** NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19. Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución. * Por razones sanitarias, no estarán permitidos los acompañantes a menos que sea necesario y esté justificado debidamente (p.ej. menores de edad). De ser posible los acompañantes deberán permanecer fuera del local. * La competencia funcionará de acuerdo a la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), por lo tanto es importante que la lean para evitar inconvenientes. Es importante recordar que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás (artículo [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3) del reglamento). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles, de acuerdo con el punto 2.6 de la [Política de Seguridad de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (categoría, no competencia), de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. **¡Importante!** **La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.** Ante cualquier duda consultar con el organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. **English:** YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF THE COVID-19. Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * For safety reasons, guests won't be allowed inside the venue, unless a competitor requires a guest for any justified reason (e.g. minors). In that case, guests should remain outdoors if possible. * Competition will be held in accordance with the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue. So, please read the WCA Safety Policy to avoid any issue. * Competitors must provide their own puzzles in accordance with 2.6 of the [WCA Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf). * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with the article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. **Important!** **The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.** For any question, contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.information: NZ North Island Championship 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2021 is the second regional championship held in New Zealand in the lead up to Nationals later in 2021.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information: **English:** CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration. ___ **Deutsch:** Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0FJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46f5e03d373ccc1422360774454c53cb532739d2/latest%20medium%20def.png, height=3.5cm)

Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 is the 11th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.
